description:
A multi-platform launcher for your anime games

Twintaillauncher is a multi-platform launcher that brings mod support, quality-of-life improvements, and advanced features to a variety of anime-styled games.
Games
- Fixed Arknights Endfield bootup issues
Updates
3.0.0 is still heavily being worked on! This is still very very massive update and dont expect any alpha builds for atleast a month or two, 2.x branches are in maintenance mode
Happy gaming
